(* -----------------Differential Rate CEvNS-----------------*)
differentialRateEmpiricalNN[ResponseDataFunction_,ER0_,source0_:"SNS",nuflavor0_:"all",gsq0_:0,Mmed0_:1]:=Module[{ER=ER0,A,Z,gsq=gsq0,Mmed=Mmed0,nuflavor=nuflavor0,J,T,source=source0,flavor,ifmu,rate},(*,rate*)
(* Check that the neutrino flux has been loaded *)
If[neutrinoFluxTot==None,Print["Loading neutrino flux for the first time..."];];
If[ListQ[ER],(*如果输入已经是列表*)ERList=ER,(*如果输入是数值，将其转换为列表*)ERList={ER}];
(*Print[ERList];*)
rate=Table[0,{Length[ERList]}];
A=ResponseDataFunction["basic"]["A"];
Z=ResponseDataFunction["basic"]["Z"];
J=ResponseDataFunction["basic"]["J"];
T=ResponseDataFunction["basic"]["T"];
(* CrossSectionCEvNS的量纲是cm^2/keV，neutrinoFluxTot - Empirical的量纲是 neutrinos/cm^2/MeV *)
(* 那单位不是有问题？cm^2/keV * 1/cm^2/MeV 就是 1/(keV MeV) *)
(* 这个量纲属实没有办法理解 2024-08-05 *)
(* 估计是积分掉了Enu(MeV)之后，其实就是dN/dER(/keV) *)
Which[
nuflavor=="all",(*Print["all"];*)integrand[ER_,Enu_]:=differentialCrossSectionNN[ResponseDataFunction,ER,Enu]*neutrinoFluxTot[Enu],
nuflavor=="mmb",(*Print["mmb"];*)integrand[ER_,Enu_]:=differentialCrossSectionNN[ResponseDataFunction,ER,Enu]*(neutrinoFluxList[[Flav["mu"]]][Enu]+neutrinoFluxList[[Flav["mub"]]][Enu]),
True,(*Print["True"];*)integrand[ER_,Enu_]:=differentialCrossSectionNN[ResponseDataFunction,ER,Enu]*neutrinoFluxList[[Flav[nuflavor]]][Enu]];

(*Print["Begin Cal"];*)
(*Print[source];*)
If[source=="SNS"&&(nuflavor=="all"||nuflavor=="mu"||nuflavor=="mmb"),(*Print["all or mu"];*)
ifmu=1,ifmu=0];


Do[
(* EN-GeV 0.9315-GeV transform to keV need to times 10^6 *)
EnuMin0=Sqrt[A*0.9315*ERList[[i]]/2]; (* Minimum neutrino energy required (in MeV) *)
EnuMin=Max[EnuMin0,1*10^(-3)] ;
MNkg=A*1.66054*10^(-27) ;
(*Nucleus mass in kg*)

(* EnuMax是从Flux里面读取出来的 *)
(* 所以EnuMax/min是MeV*)
(*创建一个插值函数*)
EnuList= Range[EnuMin,globalEnuMax,(globalEnuMax-EnuMin)/20]; 
{timeintegrandList,integrandList}=Timing[Map[integrand[ERList[[i]],#]&,EnuList]];
{timeinterFunc,interpFunc}=Timing[Interpolation[Transpose[{EnuList,integrandList}]]];

rate[[i]]=NIntegrate[interpFunc[Enu],{Enu,EnuMin,globalEnuMax},Method->"GlobalAdaptive",MaxRecursion->20,PrecisionGoal->Automatic,AccuracyGoal->Automatic]/MNkg+ifmu* *differentialCrossSectionNN[ResponseDataFunction,ERList[[i]],29.65]/MNkg;
(* 这里直接把EnuMax改成globalEnuMax，不知道会不会有影响 - 没有 *)
,{i,1,Length[ERList]}];
rate/(308.1) ];

(*Mathematica version of the Python program*)(*Define the efficiency function*)
efficiencyCsI2021[x_]:=Module[{a,b,c,d,fun0},a=1.32045;b=0.285979;c=10.8646;d=-0.3333;
fun0[x0_]:=Max[(a/(1+Exp[-b*(x0-c)])+d),0];
If[ListQ[x],
result=Table[0,{i,Length[x]}];
Do[result[[i]]=fun0[x[[i]]]
,{i,Length[x]}];
Return[result],
fun0[x]
]
]

(*Define the Enr_max function*)
EnrMax[a_]:=2*(52.8*^3)^2/(a*0.9315*^6)

(*Define the Eee_Quenching function*)
EeeQuenching[x_]:=Module[{a,b,c,d,y},
a=0.0554628;b=4.30681;c=-111.707;d=840.384;
y=x*10^-3;(*Convert x to keVee*)
1000*(a*y+b*y^2+c*y^3+d*y^4) (*Return keVer*)]

(*Define the P_smearing function*)
Psmearing[pe_,nr_]:=Module[{a,b,fun0,result},
a=0.0749/EeeQuenching[nr];
b=9.56*EeeQuenching[nr];
fun0[pe0_]:=(a*(1+b))^(1+b)/Gamma[1+b]*pe0^b*Exp[-a*(1+b)*pe0];
If[ListQ[pe],
result=Table[0,{i,Length[pe]}];
Do[result[[i]]=fun0[pe[[i]]]
,{i,Length[pe]}];
Return[result],
fun0[pe]
]
(*If[NumericQ[result]&&Element[result,Reals],result,0]*)
]


ifNumeric[result_]:=If[NumericQ[result]&&Element[result,Reals],result,0];

If[source=="SNS"&&(nuflavor=="all"||nuflavor=="mu"||nuflavor=="mmb"),(*Print["all or mu"];*)

(*--------先在 ER 上做 Enu 积分并插值--------*)

interER2=Module[{vals},vals=Table[Module[{EnuMin},EnuMin=Sqrt[A*0.9315*ER/2.];

integrandList=Map[integrand[ER1,#]&,EnuList];
(*integrandList=integrand[ER0,EnuList];*)

MNkg=A*1.66054*10^(-27) ;

EventRateBin9SumCsI[ResponseDataFunction_,source0_:"SNS",nuflavor0_:"all",element0_:"Cs"]:=
Module[{A,Z,J,T,source=source0,nuflavor=nuflavor0,element=element0,PEList,pbins,efft,mass},

pbins=Range[0,60,4];
mass=14.6;
efft=((0.52)+NIntegrate[Exp[-0.0492*(trec-0.52)],{trec,0.52,6}])/6;
{timeiIdRdPER1,listdRdPEResponse[element,nuflavor]}=AbsoluteTiming[Transpose[{PEList,ParallelMap[EmpiricaldNdPEResponse[ResponseDataFunction,#,source,nuflavor]&,PEList]}]];
